payload.note: General-L two-loop checkpoint: for every integer L>=5, exact affine momentum-flow enumeration reduces 96 source-conserving oriented complete-g4 two-loop flows to 21 common integrands after 48 identically zero-mode flows are removed. Absorbing bulk propagators pinned to +/-p into the same omega(p)^(-2) scale as rank-one conditioned covariances exposes five exact cancellations. All power-sized quartic-tadpole Y_L^2 and cubic-bubble/quartic-tadpole X_L*Y_L terms cancel before absolute values. The conditioning-scale remainder is the positive R_L=162*X_L^2/[N*omega(p)^2]. The cubic soft-leg inequality plus an explicit four-dimensional lattice Green-sum bound proves R_L=O((1+log L)^2), so g_L^4 R_L is bounded on the previously certified tuned asymptotically free refinement branch. Fourteen unfactorized two-loop kernels, lower-loop recombination, the full M4 sign/scaling, the nonperturbative score, and the actual interacting H^-1 moment remain open. No continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian promotion is made.
